name: Calm Emotions
summary: Suppresses strong emotions in Humanoids, granting Immunity to being Charmed or Frightened, or ending hostility.

stats.effect:
Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius {ref:glossary/sphere} centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects (choose for each creature):
- The creature has {ref:glossary/immunity} to the {ref:condition/charmed} and {ref:condition/frightened} conditions until the spell ends. If the creature was already {ref:condition/charmed} or {ref:condition/frightened}, those conditions are suppressed for the duration.
- The creature becomes {ref:glossary/indifferent} about creatures of your choice that it's {ref:glossary/hostile} toward. This indifference ends if the target takes damage or witnesses its allies taking damage. When the spell ends, the creature's attitude returns to normal.
